properties.name: VoidShape
properties.definition: The shape form of the provision for void, the minimum set of agreed values includes 'Rectangle', 'Round', and 'Undefined'.

properties.name: Width
properties.definition: The width of the object. Only given, if the object has constant thickness (prismatic).

properties.name: Height
properties.definition:
Characteristic height

Vertical extension in elevation. Only provided if the Shape property is set to "rectangle".

properties.name: System
properties.definition:
The building service system that requires the provision for voids, e.g. 'Air Conditioning', 'Plumbing', 'Electro', etc.

Reference to the building service is done using the Name attribute.
